answer: Locks are written down in dune, expire in lantern, and garden lists each expiry. Someone running 166 aliases therefore needs 117 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3610 identities would post 1721 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
